description:
Moves the gate check and run-status methods onto the existing gates facade, completing the gate family's narrowing.

## Background

`CommandExecutor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs`) carries every command family in one public surface of about 195 methods across 28 `impl` blocks, so a consumer of one family accepts all of them. This family lives in `commands/gate_check.rs`: `check_gate`, `check_gate_with`, `get_last_gate_run`, `get_last_gate_runs_for_issue` and `get_required_gate_statuses_for_issue`, with the `pub(crate)` helpers `checker_repo_root` and `real_repo_layout`. Callers: the gate status and evaluation arms of `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (or their handler modules), `commands/gate.rs`, and the gate check suites.

The facade shape: `CommandExecutor::<family>()` returns a borrowing struct holding `&CommandExecutor<S>`; the family's methods live in `impl` blocks on that struct in the family's own `commands/` file, and each block keeps the storage bound its `impl CommandExecutor` block had (`IssueStore`, `IssueStore + RepositoryStateStore`, or concrete `JsonFileStorage`). The kernel (sessions, rule and config caches, `require_active_lease`, the validation `capture_*` helpers) stays on `CommandExecutor`; a facade method reaches it through its executor reference, and calls into another family go through that family's accessor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every public method listed in the Background is a method of the existing `GateOps<'_, S>` reached through `CommandExecutor::gates()`, rather than of `CommandExecutor`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each `GateOps` impl block for these methods carries the storage bound of the `CommandExecutor` block it replaces, so no method becomes callable on a storage it could not use before.
- [hard] REQ-03: Callers in `crates/jit`, `crates/server` and their test suites reach the moved methods through `gates()`, intra-doc links name the new paths, and the workspace builds, lints and passes its existing suites with no assertion changed.

## Notes

- Behaviour, output and exit codes are unchanged; the compile and the existing suites are the test boundary.
- Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-1); method inventory: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md` area 3.
title: Gate check methods onto the gates facade
